neighbours.label: calling something a key or main element ('one of the key things', 'the more important component', 'one of the first')
fire: Safety is one of the key things to check at a daycare.
Fatigue is often one of the first real symptoms.
The goalkeeper is usually the most important component of the team.
Trust is one of the main things that holds a family together.
Good lighting is one of the key elements of a photo.
The engine is the most important part of the car.
Water is among the first things to pack for a hike.
Timing is a crucial component of any joke.
quiet: Safety gates are sold at the shop near the daycare.
Fatigue went away after a long weekend at the beach.
The goalkeeper wears green and stands near the post.
Trust me when I say the family lives near the lake.
Good lighting costs a lot in a small town.
The engine is under the hood of the car.
Water fell from the roof during the night.
Timing belts are sold in the back of the store.
